cues.v3-cap-0004: Exodus Seven has picked up a signal without coordinates. Five pieces, one for each station. And two fingerprints in every piece.
cues.v3-cap-0004.7-9: Exodus Seven has caught a signal. We don't know where it's from. Five pieces, one per station. Each piece has two traces.
cues.v3-ai-0015: Communications has rebuilt the message: Find the fourth world. Sender unknown.
cues.v3-cap-0024: You're no longer passengers. You're a crew. Five stations, five ways to read one signal. Every one matters.
cues.v3-ai-0035: Choose, or watch. To pause, say pause, or make the sign.
cues.v3-cap-0043: We're preparing to leave. When five appears, we'll count together.
cues.v3-cap-0109: Earth is falling behind. Look closely. When we see it again, we'll see it with new eyes.
cues.v3-ai-0125: Crew stable. Wonder exceeds my calculations. I'll leave it that way.
cues.v3-ai-0136: Navigation confirms our heading. The signal leads to a source of light. Our first destination.
cues.v3-ai-0206: Siwarha. Here, the feelings you choose to show become light.
cues.v3-ai-0206.7-9: Siwarha. Here, the feelings you share turn into light.
cues.v3-light-0224: Your words take time to reach us. Colours arrive in an instant.
cues.v3-light-0236: If you'd like, choose a colour. One you'd take with you through the darkness.
cues.v3-light-0258: Every colour changes the picture. The silence between colours gives it depth too.
cues.v3-cap-0310: First clue: the signal now wears our crew's colours. I'll note that in the log.
cues.v3-ai-0352: Second destination: Kepler one eighty-six d. On this world, nothing living lives alone.
cues.v3-nature-0415: You think the self ends at the body's edge. But the air inside you passed through leaves. And your water was once a cloud.
cues.v3-nature-0433: When the seal pulses, you can touch it. You don't all need to do it at once.
cues.v3-nature-0453: I heard your rhythms. Different, but together they form one network.
cues.v3-ai-0512: Our third destination sends no message. It's waiting. It already knows we're coming.
cues.v3-ai-0534: Mann. Illness has almost disappeared here. So has distance. Risk is calculated. This civilisation predicts almost everything.
cues.v3-tech-0556: Welcome, Exodus Seven. We knew you'd come. The Captain will say: Scan the signal.
cues.v3-tech-0610: Our models accept only one answer. Tell me: what keeps a world alive?
cues.v3-tech-0610.7-9: Our machines want one answer. Tell me: what keeps a world alive?
cues.v3-tech-0635-diverse: The models required one answer. You gave several.
cues.v3-tech-0635-observe: No answer received. Sometimes, silence says something too.
cues.v3-tech-0635-same: You all chose alike. Each station sees that answer from a different angle.
cues.v3-tech-0645: I'll keep it all. Truth has more than one shape.
cues.v3-ai-0718: Memory reports something strange. The signal travels backwards through the tunnel. No one has sent it yet.
cues.v3-ai-0729: It reached us before it was sent. And it carries this crew's fingerprints.
cues.v4-saturn-01: Look at the rings! It's Saturn. We're back in the Solar System. From here, we know the way home.
cues.v4-saturn-02: From a distance, the rings look solid. Up close, they're countless pieces of ice and rock. Each one orbits Saturn.
cues.v4-saturn-03: We leave Saturn behind. Our next stop is a world of oceans, clouds and people waiting for us.
cues.v3-ai-0742: Navigation confirms. Its origin is right ahead.
cues.v3-ai-0754: The signal leaves from here. But the moment it will be sent... hasn't happened yet.
cues.v3-cap-0802: I understand. We weren't following someone else's signal. We made it, step by step.
cues.v3-ai-0809: Light gave it colour. Nature gave it rhythm. You gave it something no machine can invent: your choices.
cues.v3-echo-0820: We knew you by your light.
cues.v3-cap-0829: Log correction. The fourth world wasn't hidden. We hadn't learned to see it yet.
cues.v3-ai-0838: Message complete: Find the fourth world.
cues.v3-ai-0850: We're here with you. There's nothing left to solve. From here, we're going home.
cues.v3-ai-0908: I knew where Earth was. I didn't know why you called it home. You taught me that.
cues.v3-cap-0920: Ship's log: we sent the signal. The loop is closed.
cues.v3-ai-0930: You set out to find an unknown world. You returned to the one you knew. Now you see it differently.
cues.v3-cap-0943: Home Protocol complete. Welcome home, crew. Stay at your stations. Your guide will tell you when to stand up.
